manual_review.method: Full frozen-input, original-output and entire exact authored v2-source visual review; no function execution, benchmark or real inventory.
checks: Exactly the original two function exports with exact supplied parameter/return types and original type-only @knorvia/contracts import symbol set.
One enabled-input classification traversal uses invocation-local exact-name Maps with exact-ID occurrence buckets; no full-collection filter per output entry.
Distinct enabled names have one group and one self-ID bucket per entry; each self bucket is skipped without scanning its occurrences, so empty conflict output does not require quadratic scans.
Multiple same-name equal-ID inputs also skip their complete self bucket, preserving removal of every exact self ID and avoiding scans proportional to excluded duplicate occurrences.
For each distinct other ID bucket, every original ID occurrence is pushed; duplicates remain. Default sort determines the final conflictingPluginIds order.
Map keys use string name and ID public types, so Map identity agrees with required exact string equality without normalization or deduplication of emitted IDs.
All original inputs including disabled ones map to fresh entries in original order; disabled conflict arrays are fresh and empty.
Entry own fields retain exact order: pluginId, name, marketplace, enabled, conflictingPluginIds, skillQualifiedNames, mcpServerNames, subagentNames, rootPath.
Skill and agent sets are separate per-entry across all matching groups; trim and omit empty item names, prefix unchanged plugin name and colon, deduplicate names and default-sort.
Other component kinds are ignored; original groups/items/names are never mutated.
MCP arrays are fresh default-sorted copies with duplicates and disabled supplied MCP names retained.
IDs, names, marketplace, enabled and rootPath are copied unchanged.
Lookup still returns first exact-ID entry reference or undefined with no clone, mutation or fallback.
No shared mutable state, catches, schema repair, runtime dependency, persistence or authority operation; native metadata/getter/type errors propagate.
Source has 78 lines and remains strictly under 400.
manual_review.scaling_analysis: Manual algorithm analysis only: expected native Map classification/lookup work is linear in input size, bucket iteration/ID emission is linear in entry count plus required emitted-conflict volume; mandated output sorting and component/MCP work are additional. No measured performance claim or worst-case native Map timing guarantee.
